notice.crystal: Natural crystals are formed in the earth. Each piece is unique and not perfect. Cotton-like inclusions, veining, mineral gaps, uneven surfaces, black spots, impurities or ice cracks are natural characteristics, not man-made damage or quality defects. Goods should be inspected in person. Once a purchase is confirmed, those natural characteristics are not grounds for return, exchange or claim. To the extent permitted by law, we accept no extra liability for such natural characteristics.
notice.colour: Website photos are for reference only. Crystals show different colour and lustre under different lighting. Strong light, sunlight, white light and warm light each produce a different reflection. Screen settings and shooting conditions may also make photos differ from the actual piece. Colour, transparency, lustre and overall appearance are determined by the physical item. Differences caused by lighting, screens or photography do not mean the goods fail to match their description.
